notes.title: Roadmap for Act 3 - and Q&A answers!
notes.content:
Heya folks.

It's a good moment to combine answer some questions to questions you had, and questions you didn't ask but still deserve and need.

As such, we would like to present the honest truth for Act 3 as a get go, before moving on to the Q&A.

As it stands right now, we're posed with a genuine problem we're not in a position to resolve. As you might know and understand, Her Last Piece is quite heavy on the art division, and Her Last Piece has simply not been quite the financial success we have obviously all hoped for.

This is fine, this is not inherently the problem. The problem is what comes after. Our artist has sadly come in a position where he needs to dedicate time to other projects to be able to afford a daily life, something we had not anticipated for when starting this project, but life... well, life happens.

As it stands, the entire script is written, edited and proofread, and on the coding front we should not need a lot of time, I'd argue roughly a month, maybe two, considering most of the surrounding code has been finished already.

The problem is the art is so substantial, we're potentially looking at a year's time to get Act 3 done. We've looked at a lot of other options, but they either require resources or skills we lack. Hiring another artist is something we simply cannot consider, for example.

The only option we believe we have left is one we want to offer as an option to you, the player. We know it's immensely disappointing to have to wait a year, and it truly bothers us a lot too, but we'd like to look into changing the workflow a little to release Act 3 in parts. 

This would mean the artist would finish a part, before moving to the next. These would be several scenes, culminating in about a third of the chapter per part.

In such case, the parts could likely release every 2-4 months or so, or faster if the financial situation lets up enough to shift the work schedule.

Additionally, we could release parts in phases as well, where we initially release a part only illustrated, with no animations except for those already created in earlier acts, and then the next update is focused on animating that part.

A release schedule as such would look like this, in that case:
[i]Part 1:
1A - Illustrated
1B - Animated
Part 2:
2A - Illustrated
2B - Animated
Part 3:
3A - Illustrated
3B - Animated[/i]

It's of course hard to say how long every part/phase combination would take but we could offer you updates a lot more frequent, even if we can't offer you the full game.

Please feel free to let us know your thoughts on the matter. We're not perfect people, so perhaps you might have an idea that could resolve the situation in better ways which we haven't thought about, either.

We sincerely apologize for this letdown, but we want to stress that we will continue to finish Her Last Piece, even if it takes a year indeed.

Thank you.

---

Moving on to the Q&A:

[b]L: Lostraven (Writer)
A: AuxiliaryOut (Artist)
P: Pasix (Programmer, editor)[/b]


[b]Q: Where did you get your inspirations or ideas for Her Last Piece? Is this your first project?[/b]
[list]
[*] L: Inspirational writing. I drew Arvenia from a lot of classic gothic horror. I wanted to keep the scope small and very intimidating intentionally. There's an old saying about how all you need to do is throw a bunch of interesting people in a room and let them talk and you'll have something interesting at the end. So, between all that gothic horror was probably a little bit of the breakfast club haha... 
[*] P: This is not the first project we've worked on, but this is definitely the first project for all of us we've commandeered from beginning to end. It's a significantly different experience to work on, and arguably vastly more fun, at least to me.
[/list]

[b]Q: What was the hardest aspect of developing Her Last Piece?[/b]
[list]
[*] L: For me, as the writer, the hardest challenge was probably staying within that scope and keeping it interesting.
[*] A: All the skills to learn to make it possible. Audio editing, dubbing, the Ren'py integration side. It's alot to learn and a lot to manage.
[*] P: Adding to both of those sets of words, the challenge also lied in Ren'py itself. It's a great engine especially for visual novels, but it absolutely serves a specific route of VN'ing that can easily be broken by more 'advanced' - by lack of better phrasing - techniques such as for example full Live2D integration. Some things which you'd figure should be easily implementable can actually keep you stuck for hours, which was really quite a surprise.
[/list]

[b]Q: When creating the design for Arvenia, what were the factors in her design or what influenced her design?[/b]
[list]
[*] L: I kinda envisioned a mixture of Del Toro's work visually when it came to Arvenia, but to me, she was always this lonesome, almost Nosferatu-like figure sulking around her castle.
[*] A: When designing Arvenia, I thought it would be interesting to challenge the conventional demoness design and approach it a biiit differently. The biggest influence - and a character who I felt embodied that - was Kiss-shot Acerola-Orion.  I’m not sure if I achieved that, but to summarize what I’m feeling when working on Arvenia: sincerity between the lies.
[/list]

[b]Q: Will there be additional information or context on the wider in-universe lore (regarding other countries, other background info of the world, more expansion on what happened before the game and after the game, etc) either within the game or possibly in a future sequel of Her Last Piece?[/b]
[list]
[*] P: As it is currently planned, no. Part of the setting for Her Last Piece was and is because setting the scope and keeping within that scope is made easier if you're not trying to introduce a vast world around it. Of course you cannot entirely avoid references to the outside world, but your world is Arvenia now, you needn't concern yourself about anything else.
[/list]

[b]Q: As the developers of Her Last Piece, what were your favorite parts in the game (either game content or the development process)?[/b]
[list]
[*] A: For me personally it's when Arvenia is asking the player to come to bed. I knew I could crank the uwu up to 11 in that scene, and BOY, do I love UWU! The most fun to see take shape, is easily the chibi stage show.
[*] P: Doubling down on the chibi stage show, this is actually a really code-heavy sequence. Although almost everywhere else in the game, movement is done directly through Live2D with sparse additions of Ren'py's ATL for movement, the chibi scene is nigh-exclusively ATL, and a LOT of it. This is effectively the one scene where visually (barring the actual art of course) I had the vast majority of creative control, and I've definitely bullied aux into adding a bit more art so I could realize it in the form it is now.
[*] L: Specifically writing Arvenia whenever she was losing it or going full yandere was quite enjoyable.
[/list]

[b]Q: With the introduction of Fhaust as a new love interest, will her scenes / story be introduced in one sudden motion or will it be in addition to the developing story with Arvenia? Such as when the next act releases should we expect to be seeing a huge shift to Fhaust-focused content with Arvenia on the backburner, or will we be eased into the content? I'd personally love to see some tension-building here, as the name of the game is "Her Last Piece", I'd hope she'd be protective over what we can assume to be her last piece rather than let Fhaust plunder her love haha[/b]
[list]
[*] P: You're on the right path in terms of thinking, but as much as I'd like to spoil it, you'll just have to find out in Act 3. Rest assured we have kept balance in mind and I'm very confident you'll come to enjoy what we've come up with.
[/list]

[b]Q: I might be overthinking, but it seems as though a lot of the tension and intrigue surrounding the first scenes of the game withered away by the end of what is currently playable. Such as "She lies" made it seem like she was the aggressor, but as the story unfolded it seemed like she was more of a victim. Now before I ask this I definitely want it to be clear that this is a game to be played one handed (at least for my end), so that being said, in the next act will there be some expansion on this aspect of the story or is it being approached more mildly to make way for adult content?[/b]
[list]
[*] P: Story has - in my opinion - always been the main focus point for Her Last Piece, and with some honest brutality, I think we wouldn't even be here if it weren't for the impact of the story. Find comfort in ignorance, my child, and you shall find salvation.
[/list]

[b]
Q: How many acts total are planned for HLP in order for this specific project to be counted as complete? If the number of acts for HLP ends up going past a certain amount, say if you planned for 5 but end up enjoying it so much and getting carried away and you make 8 or 10 acts, will there be a price increase to the game to reflect the added effort, or is there security in the current price of the game and anything additional would be added as paid DLC content?[/b]
[list]
[*] P: Both happily and sadly, Act 3 is going to be the last act we make for this game at least. This has everything to do with scope and of course also the price tag. We've always wanted the game to have a low price tag, but for a low price tag you also need low production costs, and sadly they're kind of really high. If we do end up expanding the world with sidestories or prologues or such, they'll be woven into the current acts as they exist, and will not cost anything extra. We do not feel good about hiding canon content behind a paywall, as such. That said, if we do more 'skit'-esque sidestories that is considered non-canon, such as alternate universes with Fhaust and Arvenia in feudal Japan or something silly like that, we'd likely add it as DLC.
[/list]

[b]Q: Will there be any additional features to look forward to, either big or small, in future updates? Personally, I'd like to be able to name my saves. Small thing, but helps me keep track of which route I'm going for.[/b]
[list]
[*] P: On gameplay fronts, not something huge we've in the pipeline as is. We'll likely continue to shave on the project in terms of quality of life features if and when we encounter them, and likely more features you're used to in other VNs, such as an audio player when you've bought the OST pack. Additionally, we'll be looking into expanding the gallery with 'story nodes' rather than just the NSFW nodes, as we've had a few requests for such, which seems interesting to work on.
[/list]

[b]Q: What inspired the creation of Faust and the design of their plushie form?[/b]
[list]
[*] L: Fhaust's inception came from logical necessity. Dracula has his Igor, Arvenia had her Fhaust to do her bidding. From there, of course, the character was then heavily expanded. One thing I did want was to make sure Fhaust didn't talk verbally, given Arvenia's character, it would defeat the purpose a bit of just how psychologically isolated she is if she did have someone to talk to all these years.
[*] A: The idea for Fhaust started out as sort of a voodoo doll concept. But then I thought, hey, I really like cute stuff. And what's cute? That's right a big, teddy bear plushie uwu. As for specific details, I knew I just wanted big button eyes like the characters in Caroline.
[/list]

[b]Q: Were there any other VNs used as inspiration when creating Her Last Piece? What are each of the developers' favorite VNs if any?[/b]
[list]
[*] P: It's a bit of a non-answer from the coding department, but personally I really look up to Katawa Shoujo as an older example of a VN that just did everything right, but more in the same line of work, I believe Eternum from Caribdis and Vaygren from Cyberframe Studios have an immense focus on quality, and something I genuinely strive to meet in par.
[*] A: Not really anything from the get-go. Although Vaygren became a genuine source of inspiration, I only discovered them after Her Last Piece was already conceptualized.
[*] L: Not really any VNs specifically, though I drew a lot of inspiration from gothic novels.
[/list]

[b]Q: Will you include a true end for this story?[/b]
[list]
[*] P: Yes, there will be a variety of endings based both on choices you've made in Acts 1 and 2, and of course the path you choose to take in Act 3. Although none will be really considered 'false' endings, there's definitely an ending we could like to consider canon.
[/list]

[b]
Q: Will you continue doing visual novels? If you continue doing visual novels are you planning to expand this universe with prequels or sequels? Or are you more interested in making new stories?[/b]
[list]
[*] P: I absolutely have something in the pipeline - sadly knowing that Her Last Piece is going to take a while, it'll open me up for other projects, after all - which will 100% be a VN, and it will have a romance component, but it will not have any NSFW content, or at least it won't be the main focus area. (Katawa Shoujo is a big hint)
[/list]

[b]
Q: Does Arvenia like rough or submissive?:
L: Yes.[/b]

Thanks for your curiosity, patience and ongoing support~

- Spicemerchantsgames

notes.title: Update 1.1.024 - and the Supporter Pack release!
notes.content:
Hiya folks!

As per the title, as of right now, the Supporter Pack is available at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613180/Her_Last_Piece__Supporter_Pack/

It features the following contents: 

    A full walkthrough for all the acts as they are released

    A couple of exclusive outfits for Arvenia usable in the new Outfit menu

    Mastered and edited soundtracks that weren't used in-game

We might add to this as development continues, without changes in price, so all content is available whenever you'd like it!

Additionally, with this update, we've pushed a few bugfixes to bugs, complaints and suggestions we got, mostly regarding voicelines not finishing, typos, slight performance issues and some important fixes for gamepad and Steam Deck use.

Additionally, the gallery's buttons are now clarified a little more so it is actually obvious that they are buttons. Apologies for the confusion!

Last but not least, regardless if you bought the Supporter Pack, under the preferences menu, you'll now find an Outfit menu option. This lets you set - and directly overwrite - Arvenia's current outfit, or just preview them, if you like. Please note this is currently only for the sprite, we might look into options for CGs later, but this is lower on the priority list at the moment.

Thank you for your continued support!

- Spicemerchantsgames

notes.title: Act 3 News
notes.content:
Some of the words that have quickly worked their way into our regular communication are the simplest ones, but arguably the most meaningful ones, and I'll never grow tired of writing them.

[h2]Thank you.[/h2]

Thank you, for your support over the time, during our transparency of our struggles, and the overwhelming support that radiated from even that. Thank you, if you've been with us from the very beginning. Thank you, for making Her Last Piece not [i]our[/i] last piece. 

We had to take some measure of radio silence as we found our footing, delved into some sidejobs and planned and arranged for our plans, backups, backups of backups, and fallbacks. 

With great mirth, we are sharing with you the news that...

[h1]Act 3 is in progress![/h1]

Despite the feeling that we might have to continue on a deficit, the overwhelming support has made it possible for us to not only continue but finish Act 3 as a whole. So again, thank you.

Because we would not be in this stage without you, we thought it would be a good moment to actually kind of properly introduce our team, as we have not taken the opportunity to, and to thank everyone who contributed not only directly to the project, but also through other measures.

It'll be a bit of a long post, but we'll be sharing some bits of the future as well, so stay tuned!

So without further ado~

[h3]The core team:[/h3]

[b]Auxiliaryout[/b], our resident American artist, Live2D extravaganza, unnecessary workaholic, and the resulting factor in nigh everything you can visibly see ingame. His hard work and indomitable spirit is the drive behind this project.

[b]Lostraven[/b], our resident British writer, the de-facto brain of the project, the one who conceptualized and put to paper the story of Her Last Piece, and what makes Arvenia who she is. His creativity shines throughout everything we created.

[b]Pasix[/b], yours truly! The Dutchman behind all of the code, my goal and self-enforced task is to be the polish that makes my objectively vastly more creative peers shine brighter than a diamond. (Yes, I'm also responsible for the bugs and the Dutch translation. Sorry!)

[h3]Our compatriots in arms:[/h3]

[b]Sanityzer and Monty P[/b], the music-making and enhancing legendary Canadian brothers. Everything you hear in game has been their handiwork, bar the actual voice-work, which they still enhanced and mastered. Their creative skills in both music and sound bring to life what we could not, and their dedication to the game has been impeccable. Thank you!

[b]Karamelone[/b], our resident German, who helps us bring our game to you, by maintaining our socials and helping to make sure your voices are always heard. Always keeping an ear to the ground and helping us ensure our game is up to par with standards and expectations is an immense help to have. Thank you!

[b]PixieWillow[/b], the beautiful British voice actress behind Arvenia, her voice puts to words (Literally!) everything what Arvenia is and should convey. Her expertise in the profession brings Arvenia to life on the screen, and makes her feel like she would never let you go. Or... would she? Thank you!

[b]Sageras Simpson and Mai-senpai (麻衣学姐)[/b], our Chinese specialists, who translated all of the game into Chinese up until now to the utmost level of quality. With a vast experience in translating other games, these two know how to connect through a massive language barrier, and working with them has been a blast. With a double linguistic expertise, they will also be our gateway into Japanese when the time is ripe! Thank you!

[b]Locolizator[/b], our Spanish locolizator (Get it?), has ensured the translation of Act 1 to the utmost level of quality. Sadly due to little request, we haven't continued it for Act 2, but we are still thankful for his contributions and we will definitely have him onboard for the future, should Spanish become more requested. Thank you!

[b]Hades Ruler[/b], from the appropriately named [b]Hades Army[/b] - our recent Russian acquisition, currently working to translate both Act 1 and Act 2 to the lovely Russian language. With a dedication to quality, it was no doubt that we'd want someone like him handling the translation. Thank you!

[b]If you are looking for quality work for your project or commission:[/b]
All of the above are available for hire for their respective efforts! Please feel free to reach out to them directly, or feel free to contact [b]Pasix[/b] to get you acquainted. We absolutely and completely endorse all of them and we wouldn't be here without them.

[h3]Our supporters:[/h3]

It would be very cheeky to write [b]"You!"[/b] here, but at the end of the day, that is still exactly what I wrote. You, the player, are our main supporter, and the mere fact you went and decided to buy our game has been a part to allowing us to do what we love. Besides that, your feedback, suggestions and motivations are what shapes our game to be what it is.

Despite that, we would also like to point out a few key individuals, who are not necessarily more important than anyone else, but have contributed in ways that have made their own unique form of impact;

[b]Aebard[/b] - the developer of [b]Vaygren - Lustful Temptation[/b]. We have addressed it before, but [b]Aebard[/b] has effectively been walking the same path we have, with all of its struggles, hurdles, obstacles and occasional windfalls. [b]Aebard[/b] has been exceptionally kind as to not only share these with the creator of the engine we work with, but also with us, going as far as sometimes directly helping us with problems or even creating code that could help with a problem we have had. This legend has most likely chipped off a few months of dev time purely through his kindness. Thank you!

All of the creators that featured us in their shoutouts; in no particular order:
- [b]ArbuzBudesh[/b] (from [b]Team Dead Deer[/b], developing [b]Price for Freedom[/b]) Thank you!
- [b]Leopold Visette[/b] (developing [b]Valor and Glory[/b]) Thank you!
- [b]Lovestory[/b] (from the aptly named [b]Lovestory[/b], developing [b]Devoted Wife[/b] and [b]Stolen[/b]) Thank you!
- [b]Colorless and RyanReos[/b] (who probably don't need an introduction, but they do more than that Marika skin, you know!) Thank you!

The amazing folks that commissioned custom pieces to support the project:

[b]Emberwulf:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091502/36256b6ada09a4f87fa24ade966166b9012a5c9f.png[/img]

A commission featuring a character from a story they've worked on, displayed in [b]Auxiliaryout[/b]'s artstyle. Plate always does well, doesn't it? Thank you!

[b]SevereArtisan:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091502/87704384efd3666ec09f8ca309c4f8b88017ec62.png[/img]

A commission for an original character, displayed in [b]Auxiliaryout[/b]'s artstyle. White hair and red eyes are always a classic. Thank you!

[b]Mr. Zer0[/b], who contributed an unnecessarily large amount of money in one go, without even requesting anything back for it. Thank you!

The current [b]32 paying and 253 total members[/b] of our Patreon at https://www.patreon.com/HerLastPiece, who support us either financially or by being a part of our fanbase. Thank you!

Everyone in the Steam comments, discussions and our Discord at https://discord.gg/t3yKctXWgz.

All of our friends who did playtesting, gave feedback or helped with smaller tasks in their own ways. Thank you!

[h2]So what's next?[/h2]

Upon request, we've started working on something we've dubbed a 'Supporter's Pack' next to the OST pack. We're still working on making it worthwhile to purchase, and we're still open to suggestions or thoughts on the matter, if you'd be willing to share.

Currently we have in mind the following;
- A few special costumes/garbs for Arvenia to wear, which will also add an option to overwrite the costume Arvenia wears in the moment.
- Some very custom tracks from our resident musicians, which didn't end up getting used in the game for one reason or another.
- Sketches for artwork that have or have not made it into the game
- A walkthrough for the game, with both paths, secrets and some interesting notes you might've missed.

The OST pack will feature all of the music currently ingame and will be extended with music that is to come (without additional cost, if you already bought the OST pack, of course).

Additionally, we're also thinking of some minor items that will allow you to share your support or just to use in general of course - things for the Steam point store, trading cards and badges, for example.

With Act 3 confirmed, we're circling back from our side hustles and rearranging our schedules to dedicate our time to Her Last Piece properly again. The preparations are already well underway and full development is to start relatively soon. Preferably we would've had a date for the Supporter's Pack and OST ready for you, but with somewhat chaotic schedules still, we'd rather be silent than wrong, on the matter.

Last but not least, we'd love to hear what your thoughts are on both the game and the Supporter's Pack. What are you missing? What would you like to see in Act 3? What are you most positive about? What do you dislike the most? We'd love to hear from you!

Until the next dev progress post!

Love,

- Spicemerchantsgames

notes.title: Thoughts?
notes.content:
Hiya folks!

First of all we'd like you to know we're working on a hotfix as we speak. It will tackle all of the bug reports we've gotten thus far which we're grateful for, which includes the steam achievements currently not working.

We'd also like to thank you for the extremely positive reception we've gotten. It's a blessing to have our hard work be rewarded with such kind words, as it's not always easy to get rid of the doubts in your mind when developing, which brings me to a hopefully small request.

Some of the troubles with Early Access releases are - as we have discovered - the fact that it's harder to get feedback on newer versions of the game when it's former update has already been out a while. The idea of Early Access has always been appealing to us because we could retroactively implement and fix things that we did not think of before or we could do way better at, and based on the current reception, I'd like to think we did well!

But the honest fact of the matter is we don't have a large amount of feedback and/or criticism to pull from, especially considering Act 1.

As such, it would help us immensely if you'd be willing to let us know your thoughts - even if you believe the direction we're going in is already great, so we can can take this feedback and use it to formulate our future plans more accurately.

You're most welcome to do so in our Discord or the comments, but if you'd like to help us out, a review on Steam would also do great to help newcomers to Her Last Piece understand what our game is about and what you liked (or disliked) about it.

The important part to us is that whatever you do, you're honest. Negative reviews are welcomed as much as positive ones, because it shows us what we can do better, but of course our aim is to turn them all into positive ones in due time.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Love,

- Spicemerchantsgames|

notes.title: Act 2 Release
notes.content:
Hello peoples! :D

First and foremost an apology - we promised a communique if we had an idea of a delay, and we have not informed you there wouldn't be one. That is because pretty much up until the release, we've been working and testing, and we - for the longest moment - were not sure we'd be able to make the deadline, but also weren't sure if it'd be extended. Either way...!

Without further ado, and with great pleasure, we present to you; Act 2! As of exactly right now, you will be able to download and play the continuation of the story of Her Last Piece!

A rough changelog:
- More than double the amount of lewd scenes from Act 1
- About 1.5x the amount of story from Act 1
- Several new CGIs and rooms to discover
- More than a dozen additional music tracks to enjoy
- Several quality of life improvements based on YOUR feedback
- Optimalisations, both on filesize and performance

A few important notes:
Because we went back to Act 1 and made some much needed improvements, we decided to double down and add some improvements from what we've learned based on your feedback and from Act 2. This means it is NOT save safe. We're terribly sorry, but we've taken countermeasures to avoid this in the future. Regardless, we invite you to explore Act 1 once more. Most of the story will be as you remember it, but we've made significant improvements on both art, flow and animation which we're sure you'll enjoy!

Due to some technical constraints we've decided at this time not to extend the Spanish and Dutch translations into Act 2. Simplified Chinese however is included with this release! We will look into potentially continuing Spanish and Dutch later down the road, if there's enough interest.

If you've come this far, we'd like to address one more matter; you!

First of all, we cannot overstate how glad we are to have not only your support, but your patience. We're a a small team of three people, give or take help from friends and a few contractors who we are eternally grateful for.

Leading directly into that, we'd also like to thank and highlight some of our friends who made this deadline possible - despite our concern that we might miss it - our friends from Cyberframe Studios, who you might know from their up and coming game; Vaygren - Lustful Temptation!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771700/Vaygren__Lustful_Temptation/

A similarly small team, the creators behind this game have encountered many of the struggles that we have in the course of development, have made many mistakes, and faced several obstacles - all of which we didn't have to, because of their assistance, guidance and help.

We would not have come this far and would not have reached this absolute milestone without them - and we hope you'll find their game as great a joy to play as ours!

As for the future, we'll be sticking close to Act 2's release the coming few days, just in case our testing did miss bugs and we need to apply hotfixes quickly. After such, we'll be drafting up a plan for the future which we'll inform you about as soon as possible!

We look forward to your feedback - bug reports are as always very much welcome and wanted at our Discord over at https://discord.gg/GYsuX4mk

With love

- Spicemerchantsgames

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Good day everyone!

First of all thank you for playing our game, leaving your feedback, suggestions, reviews and so much more. We're sad to see that despite our attempts at rigorous bugfixing, some still managed to slip through, notoriously so getting stuck on gallery scenes despite not even entering the gallery.

The hotfix took a little since our programmer sadly got feverish a little before release up until now, but the gallery bug should be fixed, making the game playable again. 

We look forward to your thoughts on the game!

- Spicemerchantsgames
